Cat Places Rules

Cat Places is a logic puzzle: find the one right spot for every cat. Everything can be worked out step by step - you never have to guess.

The rules

One per row, column and room
The field has as many rows and columns as it has rooms - 5, 7 or 8. Every row, every column and every room (bordered by thick lines) holds exactly one cat.
No touching
Two cats never touch: not side by side, not one above the other and not at a corner. The eight cells around a cat stay free.
Playing
Tap a cell once to put a cat there, a second time for a dot - your own note that no cat goes there - and a third time to clear the cell. Cats that break a rule get a dashed frame.
Levels
Easy: 5 x 5, Medium: 7 x 7, Hard: 8 x 8. On Easy it is enough to look at single rows, columns and rooms; Medium also needs you to think one cat ahead, Hard to compare several rooms with several rows.
Help
Undo takes back your last tap. Hint frames a cat in the wrong place, or a cell where a cat belongs. There is no time limit.

Example

A small field with four rooms: every row, column and room holds one cat, and no two cats touch, not even at a corner.
